mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h_device (ape_id, name, stream_source_type, direct_source_url, play_url, zlm_proxy_key, device_type, gb_device_id, gb_platform_id, gb_channel_id, last_seen_at, sync_source, resource_type, sub_type, ip_addr, port, org_index, org_name, place_code, place, is_online, producer, producer_name, parent_code, zlm_server_id, sva_server_id, monitor_status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{ape_id}, #{name}, IFNULL(UPPER(#{stream_source_type}), 'DIRECT'), #{direct_source_url}, #{play_url}, #{zlm_proxy_key}, IFNULL(UPPER(#{device_type}), 'RTSP'), #{gb_device_id}, #{gb_platform_id}, #{gb_channel_id}, #{last_seen_at}, #{sync_source}, #{resource_type}, #{sub_type}, #{ip_addr}, #{port}, #{org_index}, #{org_name}, #{place_code}, #{place}, #{is_online}, #{producer}, #{producer_name}, #{parent_code}, IFNULL(#{zlm_server_id}, 1), IFNULL(#{sva_server_id}, 1), IFNULL(#{monitor_status}, 'STOPPED'), #{create_time}, #{update_time})

INSERT INTO h_device (ape_id, name, stream_source_type, direct_source_url, play_url, zlm_proxy_key, device_type, gb_device_id, gb_platform_id, gb_channel_id, last_seen_at, sync_source, resource_type, sub_type, ip_addr, port, org_index, org_name, place_code, place, is_online, producer, producer_name, parent_code, zlm_server_id, sva_server_id, monitor_status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{ape_id}, #{name}, IFNULL(UPPER(#{stream_source_type}), 'DIRECT'), #{direct_source_url}, #{play_url}, #{zlm_proxy_key}, IFNULL(UPPER(#{device_type}), 'RTSP'), #{gb_device_id}, #{gb_platform_id}, #{gb_channel_id}, #{last_seen_at}, #{sync_source}, #{resource_type}, #{sub_type}, #{ip_addr}, #{port}, #{org_index}, #{org_name}, #{place_code}, #{place}, #{is_online}, #{producer}, #{producer_name}, #{parent_code}, IFNULL(#{zlm_server_id}, 1), IFNULL(#{sva_server_id}, 1), IFNULL(#{monitor_status}, 'STOPPED'), #{create_time}, #{update_time})

INSERT INTO h_device (ape_id, name, device_type, gb_device_id, gb_platform_id, gb_channel_id, last_seen_at, sync_source, play_url, is_online, zlm_server_id, monitor_status, stream_source_type, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{ape_id}, #{name}, 'GB28181', #{gb_device_id}, #{gb_platform_id}, #{gb_channel_id}, NOW(), #{sync_source}, #{play_url}, #{is_online}, #{zlm_server_id}, #{monitor_status}, 'PLATFORM', NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), gb_platform_id = VALUES(gb_platform_id), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at), sync_source = VALUES(sync_source), play_url = VALUES(play_url), is_online = VALUES(is_online), monitor_status = VALUES(monitor_status), update_time = NOW()
